newsitem.title: USA: Global Telecommunication to offer common.
newsitem.headline: Global Telecommunication to offer common.

text.p: Global Telecommunication Solutions Inc said Friday it filed a registration statement with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission covering a $20,000,000 proposed public offering of shares of its common stock.
The offering is being made through a group of underwriters represented by GKN Securities Corp, Global said.

The underwriters have been granted an over-allotment option to purchase from the company the number of shares of common stock equal to 10 percent of the shares sold in the public offering, Global said.
